text:
sarah: heads up — our sampling rate for proxy telemetry seems inconsistent with console's aggregator during the sdk-proxy canary. console shows ~3x fewer requests in quota dashboard :confused:
kevin: saw that too. looks like sampling header not propagated through internal proxy for batched requests
ada: can you paste an example request/headers? my guess is SDK default sampler = 0.01 so missing header would explain the delta
sarah: example (redacted):
```http
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.local
authorization: Bearer ****
x-rd-sample: 0.05
x-rd-route: customer.pool-A
content-length: 1024
```
harry: confirmed — the proxy middleware strips unknown x-rd-* headers when we compact internal forwarding to the upstream service (we did this to avoid header explosion)
kevin: root cause then. aggregator only trusts client-sent x-rd-sample. if proxy strips it, console counts fewer sampled events => quota/emb dashboards look wrong
ada: options: 1) proxy preserve x-rd-* allowlist 2) proxy add sampled flag in body when header absent 3) server re-hydrate sampling (but that'll change effective sampling distribution)
sarah: SDKs are also inconsistent. python sends x-rd-sample on the first request in a batch, ts sends per-subrequest. so we have a mismatch in how sampling is surfaced upstream too
harry: easiest immediate fix is add allowlist to proxy for x-rd-sample/x-rd-route/x-rd-origin. tiny patch. longer term we should standardize SDK behavior
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: eng-platform/proxy v2.4.1 -> canary at 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z (ticket #PROXY-412) :rocket:
kevin: timeline coordination: we should avoid doing SDK release while canary runs otherwise we'll see spikes in telemetry mismatch
ada: propose two-step plan: short-term: proxy allowlist patch + console aggregator treat missing header as "unknown-sampled" (don’t drop events). medium-term: SDKs bump minor, attach sampling per-subrequest and add an opt-in header flag `x-rd-sample-mode: per-request`
sarah: agree. owners: harry -> proxy PR, kevin -> console aggregator tweak + dashboard alert, ada -> SDK note + opt-in flag proposal
harry: opening PR in 25m: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/412 (draft)
kevin: I'll add an ad-hoc job to reprocess last 6h of events and reconcile counters, plus a dashboard tile: "proxy preserved samples / client-sent samples" :bar_chart:
ada: SDK side: recommend feature flag name `preserve-sampling-v2` and a minor version bump for python/ts. will draft a changelog and compatibility note for devex
sarah: can we land proxy patch today and hold SDK rollout until after reconciliation?
harry: yes, if CI green. will push for expedited review
kevin: agree. I'll coordinate on PR review and tagging the release. also adding a tiny telemetry test to the console pipeline to catch header stripping regressions
ada: copying in SDK owners channel in the action item doc. will propose rollout windows and opt-in migration plan
sarah: final request: add a permanent alert when preserved_samples_ratio < 0.9 for any 1h window — that should catch regressions early
kevin: adding alert to pager duty runbook and console SLOs now
sarah: thanks all. filing short postmortem note after reconciliation. closing the loop in this thread. :white_check_mark:
